uses scale

  • CURIE: gmeow:usesScale
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usesScale
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms

The score scale a rubric or criterion uses. Domain-free (rubric-level default, criterion-level override — the holder is whatever points here); functional: one scale per holder, the gmeow:hasUnit convention.

Structure

Property shape: object property; ? -> gmeow:ScoreScale; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:usesScale from ? to gmeow:ScoreScale when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
